brief: Explain, with citations to official Python documentation, when pathlib.Path.resolve() raises an error and how strict mode changes behavior. Deliver a concise Markdown answer.
Use official Python documentation to explain how csv.DictReader handles headers and missing fields. Deliver a cited Markdown answer with a small example.
Research the official Python json documentation and explain the difference between json.load and json.loads, including one common error. Deliver a cited Markdown note.
Use official Python documentation to explain how to create and activate a virtual environment on Windows. Deliver a cited Markdown checklist.
Use official Python documentation to explain how asyncio.TaskGroup handles exceptions from child tasks. Deliver a short cited Markdown answer.
Use MDN documentation to explain AbortController with fetch and what aborting does to a request. Deliver a cited Markdown answer.
Use MDN documentation to explain native HTML form constraint validation and the roles of required and pattern. Deliver a cited Markdown checklist.
Use MDN documentation to explain CSS grid minmax() and one responsive layout use. Deliver a short cited Markdown answer.
Use MDN documentation to compare localStorage and sessionStorage lifetimes. Deliver a cited Markdown table.
Use official Playwright Python documentation to explain why locators are preferred for resilient interactions. Deliver a cited Markdown answer with one short example.

Build a responsive one-page website for fictional neighborhood reading room Riverlight. Audience: local families. Include mission, visiting information placeholders, and a clear inquiry path. Use a calm editorial visual direction. Do not invent an address or opening hours.

Build a responsive portfolio site for photographer Jun Park. Audience: art directors. Use a restrained black-and-cream visual direction with accessible navigation, areas of work, and contact invitation. No invented clients, exhibitions, awards, or email.

Build a responsive menu landing page for fictional cafe Harbor Bean. Audience: nearby residents. Show sample menu categories clearly labeled as illustrative, a visiting section awaiting confirmed address and hours, and a contact invitation. Use warm earthy design.

Build a local-only workshop registration demo page for a fictional creative writing class. Include accessible form fields, validation, and confirmation that works without a server. Clearly state that no registration is transmitted.

Build a responsive schedule page for a fictional one-day community arts event called Open Studio Day. Include three invented sessions clearly presented as demo content, location and date placeholders, and mobile navigation.

Build a local browser budgeting calculator with income and expense inputs, category totals, and an accessible summary. Save runnable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; verify calculations with meaningful checks.
Build a local habit tracker that can add, mark, and delete habits and persists state in localStorage. Make it keyboard accessible and responsive. Provide runnable files and verify core interactions.

Build an accessible FAQ page for a fictional public library service. Include search or category filtering, clear open/close interactions, and responsive layout. Use clearly illustrative policy text, not asserted real library rules.

Build a launch page for fictional note-taking app Orbit Notes. Audience: students. Include product overview, three explicitly illustrative benefits, FAQ, and a nonfunctional waitlist clearly labeled as a demo. Use a crisp blue visual direction.

Build a local reading journal page for parents with add/edit/delete entries, date and title fields, localStorage persistence, and mobile layout. Use no backend or external data; verify essential behavior.
Inspect official Python dataclasses documentation and create a CSV of three documented field options with columns option,meaning,evidence_url. Add a short cited Markdown note.
Inspect MDN documentation for main, nav, and article elements. Produce a JSON array with element, purpose, and evidence_url, plus a cited Markdown summary.
Inspect W3C WAI guidance on image alternative text. Produce a Markdown checklist with source links and a CSV of three image situations and recommended alt-text treatment.
Inspect official Playwright Python guides for file uploads and downloads. Produce a two-row CSV with task,API,evidence_url and a short cited Markdown note.
Inspect official Python logging documentation. Produce a CSV of documented logging levels with level,purpose,evidence_url and a cited Markdown explanation of when to choose a level.
Inspect MDN CSS media query documentation. Produce a JSON file describing three documented media features with feature,use,evidence_url and a cited Markdown note.
Inspect official SQLite documentation for date and time functions. Produce a CSV of three functions with function,description,evidence_url and a short cited Markdown note.
Inspect official Git documentation for git status and git diff. Produce a two-row CSV with command,purpose,evidence_url and a cited Markdown usage note.
Inspect MDN HTTP status documentation. Produce a JSON file with five representative status codes, their meanings, and evidence URLs, plus a short cited Markdown note.
Inspect official Python argparse documentation. Produce a CSV of three documented argument actions with action,behavior,evidence_url and a cited Markdown note.
